subject: Workplace Skills
title: Networking During Job Searches
description: A quick win: understand Networking During Job Searches.

hook.text: He applied to 200 jobs online with zero responses. One coffee chat with a former colleague landed him an interview.

buildup.text: Job boards are competitive. Hundreds apply for each posting. Referrals bypass the pile and go straight to review.

discovery.text: A referral is 10 times more likely to result in a hire than a cold application. Your network is the shortcut.

twist.text: Don't ask 'are you hiring?' Ask 'who should I talk to in your company about this area?' It's easier to answer.

climax.text: Activate your network before applying. Let five people know you're looking. Opportunities find you through them.

punchline.text: Referrals beat resumes. Activate your network first.

quiz.question: What's the most effective way to use networking during a job search?
options: Ask every contact if their company is hiring
Ask contacts who you should talk to about a specific area
Send your resume to everyone in your network
